canonical_data: flow definitions as JSON graphs, plus chat message history and run logs
strengths: Plain MIT with no carve-outs and no separately licensed enterprise directory, the least encumbered option among comparable builders
A separate executor package runs exported flows statelessly with no database and no interface, decoupling the runtime from the builder
Flows version as normalized JSON with command-line validate, push, pull, and export, giving canvas work a real delivery path
weaknesses: No human approval or pause-for-review primitive is documented, unlike comparable builders
One structured output mode silently skips playground events and chat-history writes, creating an observability gap
Marketing advertises a free cloud account that no retrievable first-party service page or documentation supports
why_it_matters: The permissively licensed canvas whose flows run as portable JSON outside the builder, making visual authoring compatible with code-based deployment.
